$comment: Every kid-facing sentence (PLAN_V2 §7.10): keys → sentences of ≤ 12 words, reading age 7. Placeholders are {name}. Raw codes never reach the DOM. Owned by lane F; keys are referenced by the core (reason_key, summary_key, message_key, rel_key, note_key) and by Python (warning/error events, HTTP error bodies).
